title: Market-Defined ATR Stop and Reverse-Solved Lot

research_height.transfer_path: A causal completed-bar ATR sets each treated entry's stop distance, the unchanged gross-risk budget solves lot downward, and the resulting minimum-lot feasibility, fills, risk, component economics and portfolio drawdown determine whether the micro geometry survives at portfolio height.

central_question: For the five market-entry components, does replacing account-budget-solved stop distance with a component-local completed-bar ATR stop and reverse-solving lot remove material stop-regime drift while preserving feasibility and improving later P4 portfolio efficiency versus the native contract?

research_bundle.name: fit_native_atr_geometry_then_compare_native_vs_atr_reverse_lot
roles: FIT_NATIVE_GEOMETRY: derive one outcome-free median native-stop/ATR14 multiplier per treated component from 2026-01-02 through 2026-03-31
NATIVE_SELECTION: continuous native control through 2026-05-31, judging only 2026-04-01 through 2026-05-31
ATR_REVERSE_LOT_SELECTION: identical native prefix through 2026-03-31, then the frozen ATR stop and reverse-lot intervention through 2026-05-31
conditional_latest_roles: NATIVE_LATEST: continuous native control through 2026-08-20, judging only 2026-06-01 through 2026-08-20
ATR_REVERSE_LOT_LATEST: identical native prefix through 2026-03-31, then the frozen intervention through 2026-08-20

why_now.current_bottleneck: The source contract fixes lot by a $150 balance staircase, computes a 2-percent gross stop budget, then searches for the farthest stop that consumes it while recording 4 percent planned risk. That makes initial stop geometry partly an account path rather than a market state.
why_now.connection_bridge: The intervention directly changes the project's stop, lot, minimum-lot feasibility and capital scaling while leaving signals, hold, risk fractions, admission accounting and Passive unchanged.
why_now.perspective_distance: Unit 061 was a macro source-free admission-funnel reconstruction and closed invalid. Unit 062 stays in Program 5 only because it changes data role, height and causal stage: a direct micro stop/lot intervention with later portfolio transmission.
why_now.difference_from_unit_025: Unit 025 asked whether native account-generated stop width predicted outcomes and selected no conditional response. Unit 062 does not condition on native width; it replaces the generating direction of the contract and tests the resulting portfolio causally.
why_now.difference_from_deposit_capital_v1: Deposit-capital V1 compared starting deposits and deposit-matched scale. Unit 062 keeps reference capital at $100 and asks whether stop geometry drifts inside one continuous balance path because lot is stair-stepped while risk capital is proportional.
why_now.passive_exclusion: Passive remains exactly native because changing its pending-order volume would also change durable pending-order recovery and historical reconstruction semantics. It is an untreated portfolio control, not a rescued sixth sizing variant.

whole_map_recomparison.program_2: No new causal external source is ready after invalid Unit 058.
whole_map_recomparison.program_3: The all-slot clock proposal remains connected but first needs a bounded causal definition that does not become a time-window search.

decision_translation.if_selection_and_latest_pass: Retain exactly one later independently declared binding-long plus isolated-latest confirmation question for the five-component market-stop/reverse-lot profile. No implementation or Live promotion occurs in Unit 062.
decision_translation.if_selection_fails: Do not open latest paths; preserve native stop/lot and close the axis.
decision_translation.if_selection_passes_latest_fails: Reject the candidate and preserve native stop/lot.
decision_translation.if_minimum_lot_fails: Record that the market-defined stop cannot maintain the frozen gross-risk contract at $100 and do not widen the stop or exceed risk to rescue it.

frozen_intervention.atr_information_set: fourteen completed bars strictly before the decision; true range uses the preceding completed close and therefore requires fifteen completed bars
frozen_intervention.fit_multiplier: For each treated component, the exact median across every valid native market-entry plan in FIT_NATIVE_GEOMETRY of absolute(native entry minus native initial stop) divided by ATR14. No outcome, close, direction subgroup or trimming enters the fit.
frozen_intervention.activation: Candidate paths run native through 2026-03-31 and activate the frozen profile at server 2026-04-01 00:00:00.
frozen_intervention.candidate_stop: entry price minus direction times fitted component multiplier times ATR14, snapped outward to the symbol tick grid and rejected if it violates the frozen executable-side minimum protection distance.
frozen_intervention.target_gross_risk: ConservativeRiskCapital times 0.04 times (1 minus 0.25 unmodelled reserve minus 0.25 placement headroom), identical to native.
frozen_intervention.reverse_lot: Choose the greatest valid broker volume step whose GrossStopRisk at the frozen candidate stop does not exceed target gross risk. Search only the finite broker min-to-max volume grid; do not round up.
frozen_intervention.minimum_lot_rule: If broker minimum volume exceeds target gross risk at the market stop, block the entry and log MARKET_STOP_MIN_LOT_BLOCK. Do not tighten/widen the stop, exceed target risk or borrow risk.
frozen_intervention.planned_risk_accounting: After a feasible stop and lot, preserve the native BufferedPlannedRisk check and record the unchanged 4-percent position budget for the 12-percent aggregate admission ledger. Unit 061 risk-accounting semantics are not repaired or changed.
frozen_intervention.frozen_other_behavior: All signals, evaluation times, directions, holds, Passive pending logic, RC4 ARC logic, costs, slippage stress, session/calendar, margin, position/aggregate fractions, ownership, protection reconciliation and order semantics remain inherited.

pre_outcome_feasibility.scope: Only file identity, lifecycle-start event type, component and server date were read. ATR, native stop/ATR ratios, balance-path drift, candidate lot/stop, min-lot blocks, close outcomes, portfolio metrics and candidate gates remain unopened.

fixed_fit_gate: FIT_NATIVE_GEOMETRY is the first Tester path and must pass the complete real-tick and environment integrity gate before any multiplier is read.
Every treated component has at least ten finite positive native-stop/ATR14 observations and zero ATR-unavailable row among otherwise valid native entry plans.
Each fitted median is finite, positive and frozen once in a fit receipt and candidate SET before selection control or candidate runs.
No outcome, close, P/L, stop incidence or selection metric may influence a multiplier.
fixed_real_tick_and_environment_gate: Every executed path uses Model=4 Every tick based on real ticks, terminates normally and reports 100% real ticks.

The detailed agent log contains zero absent real-tick minute, discarded real-tick minute, every-tick generation substitution, tick mismatch, load fault or synchronization fault for US30, US100 and US500 over the consumed path.
Source, SET, EX5, complete consumed raw-tick manifest and required symbol contract/swap fingerprints retain their frozen identities.
Each control/candidate pair is adjacent and has identical before/after required-symbol fingerprints; any mid-pair drift invalidates the complete pair.
The candidate and its adjacent control have exact common-prefix core event payload through 2026-03-31, excluding the explicitly added stop/lot observation events.
fixed_mechanism_gate: In NATIVE_SELECTION, at least three of five treated components have an absolute selection-median divided by fit-median stop/ATR shift of at least 0.15, and the median absolute component shift is at least 0.15.
Every accepted candidate treated entry has a stop/ATR ratio equal to its frozen multiplier within one symbol tick divided by ATR plus 1e-9.
Candidate ATR-unavailable rate is zero and MARKET_STOP_MIN_LOT_BLOCK is no more than 0.10 of otherwise valid candidate sizing attempts.
At least 0.20 of accepted candidate treated entries use a volume different from the native daily-ladder volume that would apply at the same stressed balance.

fixed_selection_gate.density: Both paths cover all 43 frozen normal dates, have at least 60 total first fills, both natural books and all six components, with at least five treated-component first fills each.
fixed_selection_gate.portfolio_value: Candidate segment stressed net is positive and exceeds control by at least max(2 USD, 0.10 times absolute control stressed net).
fixed_selection_gate.drawdown: Candidate segment maximum closed drawdown is no more than 1.10 times control.
fixed_selection_gate.efficiency: Candidate stressed net divided by maximum closed drawdown is at least 1.10 times control; zero drawdown cannot create an infinite rescue.
fixed_selection_gate.turnover: Candidate first fills are at least 0.95 of control and candidate average first fills per frozen normal date is reported with zero-fill dates retained.
fixed_selection_gate.treated_breadth: At least three of five treated components improve stressed net, neither natural book is worse by more than 1 USD, and no component contributes more than 0.60 of positive portfolio improvement.
fixed_selection_gate.risk_and_stops: Candidate stressed stop-loss dollars do not exceed control, stop-loss count is no more than 1.50 times control and the complete mechanism gate passes.

fixed_latest_confirmation_gate.opening_condition: Open only when the complete selection gate passes.
fixed_latest_confirmation_gate.density: Both paths cover all 59 frozen normal dates, have at least 80 total first fills, both books and all six components, with at least eight treated-component first fills each.
fixed_latest_confirmation_gate.portfolio_value: Candidate latest stressed net is positive and no lower than control.
fixed_latest_confirmation_gate.drawdown_and_efficiency: Candidate maximum closed drawdown is no greater than control and net-to-drawdown is no lower than control.
fixed_latest_confirmation_gate.turnover: Candidate first fills are at least 0.95 of control with zero-fill dates retained.
fixed_latest_confirmation_gate.breadth: At least three of five treated components and both natural books have nonnegative candidate-minus-control stressed net.
fixed_latest_confirmation_gate.feasibility: ATR unavailable remains zero and min-lot block rate remains no more than 0.10.

fixed_verdict_rules.success: PASS_MARKET_STOP_REVERSE_LOT_RETAIN_BINDING_CONFIRMATION when fit, integrity, mechanism, selection and conditional latest confirmation all pass.
fixed_verdict_rules.selection_failure: NO_MARKET_STOP_REVERSE_LOT_SELECTION_CANDIDATE when fit and integrity pass but mechanism or selection fails; latest paths remain unopened.
fixed_verdict_rules.latest_failure: MARKET_STOP_REVERSE_LOT_LATEST_VETO_NO_CANDIDATE when selection passes but latest confirmation fails.
fixed_verdict_rules.minimum_lot_failure: MARKET_STOP_REVERSE_LOT_INFEASIBLE_AT_REFERENCE_CAPITAL when the min-lot rate alone exceeds 0.10 under otherwise valid fit/integrity.
fixed_verdict_rules.invalid: INVALID_MARKET_STOP_REVERSE_LOT_EXECUTION_OR_RECONSTRUCTION_NO_VERDICT when any source/config/binary/tick/environment/prefix/fit identity or reconstruction gate fails.
fixed_verdict_rules.ambiguous: AMBIGUOUS_MARKET_STOP_REVERSE_LOT_NO_CANDIDATE only when all integrity conditions pass but an unforeseen semantic condition blocks the frozen comparison.

stop_rules: Commit and push this declaration before the one-time source copy, source change, compile, runtime copy, ATR observation or Tester outcome.
Read the source-topology discipline and lab forward-baseline declaration before changing MQL, then copy the sole baseline exactly once into this family.
Compile once successfully after at most two implementation-only corrections, freeze source/binary/runtime, then run FIT_NATIVE_GEOMETRY first.
If fit integrity or density fails, close immediately without multipliers, selection paths, alternate date, ATR period, price normalization or MAE rescue.
After a valid fit, create exactly one fit receipt and one candidate SET containing the five medians, commit and push them before NATIVE_SELECTION and ATR_REVERSE_LOT_SELECTION.
If selection fails any required gate, do not run latest. If selection passes, run exactly the two latest paths and close under their fixed veto gate.
Do not add another ATR period, multiplier, mean/quantile, volatility estimator, stop floor, component exception, Passive intervention, risk-accounting change or subgroup rescue.
Do not inspect Program 6, query broker/account state, touch Live, promote a candidate or reopen Unit 025, deposit-capital V1 or Unit 061.
